description: Fork of exp507. qkv is NO LONGER a LUT: replaced by soft VectorToDominance(E=64, smooth, learnable T) -> all-pairs dominance (P=2016 features in (-1,1)) -> Linear -> H*(2*d_qk+d_v). Emits q,k AND v; v_lut REMOVED (v = the d_v slice). Swaps table lookup for a dense linear readout on the SAME soft-sign dominance features the LUT indexes. out_proj/residual stay TinyMHLut(soft argmax) on LION; qkv Linear on AdamW wd=0.1. Tests whether the lookup table matters vs a plain linear map of dominance features. vs exp507 1.4797 (qkv soft LUT + v_lut), exp493 1.4806, exp475 1.4962.
